label: Lifeway kefir
note: Founded 1986 in Morton Grove, Illinois, by Michael Smolyansky, a Ukrainian-born immigrant who saw kefir at a trade show in West Germany; claims about 95 % of the US kefir market

about.text: Chicago-area kefir maker founded in 1986 by Michael Smolyansky; it reports about 95 percent of the US kefir market.
